title: $160 of frustration- and it’s all in the build.. Aggh!!!
text:
$160 of frustration- and it’s all in the build.. Aggh!!!. How does one sell a bar cart with such promise at a higher price point.. Only not put in the effort to label any of the pieces- (especially the hardware!!) Yet, somehow expect a buyer to build this without an ability to follow any real instruction. Without specifics the info. is quite useless.. not to mention how much time is wasted trying to “guess” your way thru this frustrating task. Or purchasing additional hardware to complete the project! This was the situation we found ourselves in. Not good for the nerves and more upsetting knowing it could be avoided if items were specific/labeled. It took x3 capable, semi handy, educated adults taking all the content and then truly laying it out in front of us to recreate our own “how to” directions to put this together.. For this reason alone, I’d have a hard time recommending it to others.

For instance- instructions tell you to connect a “shelf” using a “screw” to the bracket… what?? Not only do you need to know the wood piece..you also need to know which piece of hardware it’s referring to.. Oh, did I mention screws are all varied lengths? Only you don’t know what needs the shorter, med. or longer size- until you; try and are unsuccessful.. Or, you complete a step only to find out that screw length could only be a correct fit for a different connection and therefore you have to undo it!! (and we all know that’s never a good thing bc, so many times it strips socket you just screwed/unscrewed into!)

You receive x1 bag filled with all of the various size screws.. nothing labeled or separated. I must also mention- in all of the pieces of hardware we were missing one set long enough to preform x1 of the tasks. We also had x1 screw length included that we only received x3 of?? Problem is, all connections on this are identical on each side so we should have received 2 or 4..?? So, did we get an extra- Or, were we missing one? Things like this I feel are not the buyers responsibility to waste their time to try and figure out… Not at the price you pay. Spending over $160 IT’s subpar with the overall expectations at this level.

Why 3 stars?? Bc I cant give it 2.5 and tbh, it is a nice sturdy option for a “first department” or game room. It isn’t an investment piece.. But if you can complete the build- you have a sturdy cart capable to hold intended items and I do love the fact this has casters on it to roll. It’s 2-tone wood/metal makes it capable to blend with a wide variety.. We matched with brown wood and black leather- a perfect combo! I didn’t mind the few blemishes in the wood as it helped it appear more vintage and distressed vs. man-made or pressed board in its appearance. Overall.. if seller could create a solid solution for assembly- including labels + itemized diagram for hardware.. I would have given this full stars!! Without it, it’s pricey for what you have to contend with. Hoping this info can help make your decision- stay safe everyone!
